issues.reason: The term-propagation rule's own fallback licenses the bare day-part — "If the antecedent's day is unknown, emit just the day-part" — and by the coreference rule's recency test the salient antecedent time is the sundown scattering, which carries no day-level terms; copying (Day 301)/(Year 1) forward across the intervening "in the morning" would assert a date the text never gives the feather strand.

gaps_confirmed: Day-of-year dating ("day 301 of Year 1"): (Day <n>) is specified as a calendar day paired with a month, so a day index with no month has no distinct encoding.

Stacked locative PPs whose inner object is a bare mass noun ("boiled ... in sea-water in the three cauldrons"): the stacked-"in" rule is stated only for a second "in <Place>" on a place NP, and a mass constant has no witness to carry an entity-side position atom, leaving two co-equal Location atoms as the only route.

Agent-nominalization with an of-phrase ("the keepers of the Harbor Row"): it passes the nominalization-oblique rule's verb-paraphrase test but falls outside that rule's stated scope (act/result/quality nouns), while the Possession genitive is scoped to relational nouns with no underlying verb.
new_gaps: Anaphoric "that night" in a multi-day / multi-strand narrative: when the recency-salient antecedent event is itself day-unanchored, term propagation degrades to the bare day-part and nothing records that the night belongs to the day just narrated — a licensed form would need to tie a day-part to an antecedent EVENT rather than to copied calendar terms.
notes: One atom the reviewer did not raise and I do not confirm as a defect: (Member sk_mire_essence_1 stored), from the prenominal participle in "the stored mire-essence", is emitted unwrapped while a past host clause wraps an appositive's typing atom — the instruction set names appositives, not restrictive participial modifiers, so it is unsettled rather than wrong, and the parse is at least consistent with its fallen/ground handling. Everything else independently checks out: the partitive shape for "thirty of the fallen feathers", the "by evening" TimeAtMost bound, the silken-vs-clay modifier-genus split, the Around/Against surface-preposition obliques, clean witness indexing, and the strength-0 distributing rule with its "no" QuantifierPhrase companion.
